notes: Sphere of light, step 1: H144 — the sky as 144,000 equal-area cells. Turn on the new H144 plate, open the 3D sky and tap anywhere: the cell lights and a glass slip gives its address (H144 + seed-of-life digits, as fine as your tap can resolve), its place in ecliptic, equatorial, galactic and invariable-plane coordinates and its 64-bit word. Tap the round frame tag to turn the grid ECL → EQ → GAL → INV.
